summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-6 reverse stock split approved at its EGM on June 8, 2026, with an effective date of June 29, 2026 (postponed from June 22). The authorized share capital was increased to $18.72 million divided into 19.5 billion ordinary shares, par value raised from $0.00016 to $0.00096 per share. No fractional shares will be issued; entitlements are rounded up. The ordinary shares will continue trading under ticker MNDR on Nasdaq, with new CUSIP G62264 133. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
